Hi Marco,

Appreciate the note — quick answers below and Marissa from Finance is looped for the formal banking details.

• Currency: We can accept EUR to our EU collection IBAN or USD to our US correspondent account. Please indicate which currency you will instruct your bank to debit so we can match settlement.

• Intermediary fees: Redwood’s standard is to receive the invoice gross (no deductions). We ask payers to send as OUR so the beneficiary receives the full invoice amount. If your bank sends SHA or BEN and the payment arrives short, we will re-invoice for the shortfall — that complicates reconciliation and delays credit.

• VAT: If StellarNet provides a valid EU VAT ID, we will issue the invoice net of VAT under reverse-charge. Please send your VAT number and the legal entity name as it appears on your VAT cert.

I’m attaching a one-page wire instruction stub and a proforma that breaks down gross vs net amounts to make routing simpler. Marissa — can you confirm the exact account numbers and correspondent details for USD (ABA + intermediary) and confirm we require OUR fees?

Hi Marco — Marissa from Finance here. Short formal guidance and the full wire stub are attached.

1) Intermediary / correspondent fees: Redwood’s Treasury policy requires the payment to be sent OUR (payer bears all fees) so the invoiced gross amount is received in full. If the payment arrives net (short) because your bank or an intermediary deducted fees, Redwood will invoice the shortfall and place the remittance on hold until topped up. We cannot accept netting against the invoice amount because it complicates tax/recognition and collections processes.

2) EUR collections: We use a single EU collection account (Redwood Inference Europe B.V.) for euro receipts. Please include the invoice number (4372) and StellarNet legal name in the Remittance/Reference field — that’s how our AR team posts the credit.

3) USD collections: Below is the correspondent routing for USD (for banks that prefer to pay USD):
   - Bank: First National Correspondent Bank
   - ABA: 021000021
   - Account name: Redwood Inference LLC / Nostro Account
   - SWIFT (if required): FNBDUS33

If your bank will not use OUR fees, we recommend instructing them to send a separate fee transfer to the correspondent or to use an OUR instruction. If you anticipate your bank will send SHA/BEN, please notify us ahead of payment so we can watch for a short credit.

4) VAT: We will re-issue invoice 4372 net of VAT once we receive your VAT number (IT12345678901) and legal name — copied below. Please see attached VAT certificate request form to confirm registered address and VAT applicability.
